notionalBasis: Where the 2025 boundary review changed an electorate, 'last' is the notional 2023 result on the new boundaries from The Tally Room (Ben Raue) with notional=true; 'margin' (votes) is then an estimate = marginPct x the predecessor seat's 2023 valid electorate votes, rounded to 10.
